verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is clearly API-first. Its docs describe a Cart API, a Feed API, full ACP/UCP checkout flows, tokenization, and webhooks, and it publishes OpenAPI definitions on GitHub and an official MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence states or shows that every UI (dashboard/Customer Area) action is also exposed through the API. The OpenAPI probe at the docs domain returned 404, but the specs on GitHub mean this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or a feature-by-feature comparison, evidence that dashboard/configuration tasks are API-accessible, and independent corroboration.
